profile.name: GRBL 三轴电动位移台
profile.description: 这是一类由 GRBL 运动控制器驱动的三轴电动位移平台，通常采用步进电机实现 X、Y、Z 方向移动，并支持回零与位置查询。在实验室中常用于显微镜样品定位、自动扫描、对焦位移和小型自动化运动控制。
profile.description_en: This is a three-axis motorized positioning stage driven by a GRBL motion controller, typically using stepper motors for X, Y, and Z travel with homing and position readback. In laboratories it is commonly used for microscope sample positioning, automated scanning, focus translation, and small-scale motion automation.

registry.name: GRBL Controller
registry.description: Grbl Controller是由GRBL (Open Source)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括位置设置、停止、关闭、写入数据、归零、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, find grbl port等操作。
